title: Native witness wrapper must canonicalize the source checkout before syncing the Windows clone
body: The first native full/shell attempts used the wrapper from the Windows clone, which self-synced its stale checkout and silently ran an older commit. The source-side wrapper should reject clone-local invocation or resolve an explicit source root and print the source/native SHA pair before running.

title: Standalone WSL configuration should derive or validate UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: A fresh WSL configure failed before target generation because UNDERTOW_ROOT was absent, even though the paired Undertow checkout is required by the codegen/text interface. The configure helper should resolve the paired checkout or fail with a one-command setup that preserves the queue contract.

title: Capture test wrappers should expose persistent output directories
body: The queue redirects producer captures to an ephemeral /tmp/undertow-box-captures root and successful CTest runs do not leave a stable evidence directory. Look-dev, planet, and cel wrappers still bake the build-tree path instead of honoring a common persistent capture-root contract, so final cross-driver evidence required manual direct runs/copies.

title: Native GPU suite helper should report and accept the canonical CTest/build paths
body: The documented native suite helper assumes ctest is on PATH and derives the build tree from its script location, while this lane had to discover the actual absolute CTest executable and nested libraries/RenderGraph test binary. The helper should print the resolved executable and build tree and accept a canonical source/native mapping.

title: Full VIXEN validation should classify the known Undertow codegen red before narrowing targets
body: The full WSL VIXEN graph target is currently blocked by the Undertow frame-target schema check (war_density Dynamic without an owning system), requiring manual scoped-target selection to validate unrelated renderer changes. The paired validation entry point should classify/report this known dependency red and provide an authoritative target scope.
